title: Weeping Stone Face
description: A sorrowful stone face weeps through a crown of ivy and roots, framed by Gothic architecture, chains, and cracked stone. This narrow nape and back-of-neck design includes a clean black-on-white outline, placement mockup, reference board, lore card, and style guide.
outline_standard: Clean black line art on white, prepared as a tattoo reference outline. Have a licensed tattoo artist review and adapt sizing and transfer setup before use.
